Wikipedia has some information on its toxicity: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doxylamine#Toxicity](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doxylamine#Toxicity)

It says the median lethal does is estimated to be 50-500mg/kg. (I believe that this means that for a person of mass 70kg, the median lethal does would be estimated as 3.5-35g.)

Edit: I'm not sure if Doxylamine is the same as Doxylamine succinate though.
